subject: Our mailbox is down: price for Chicago (ORD)
body:
Hello,

our usual mailbox has been down since this morning and I cannot open anything in it. Could you confirm your price for our shipment to Chicago (ORD) to this address, so that I can pass it on today?

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg

classification.reasoning: The customer asks us to confirm the price for a shipment to Chicago, which requires an answer.
